runs.text: Which dog is Israel? Six clues. Small. About twenty two thousand square kilometres. Roughly New Jersey. Smart. six point three percent of its economy goes into research. Number one among rich countries. Loyal. Since nineteen forty eight, about three point four million immigrants came home. Guards the house. Iron Dome stops over ninety percent of rockets aimed at its cities. Blamed for every bark. From twenty fifteen to twenty twenty three, the United Nations General Assembly passed one hundred and fifty four resolutions against Israel. Everyone else combined? seventy one. A <<ˈ|d|ɛ|z|ɚ|t>> dog that found water: drip irrigation was born here, in nineteen sixty five. And it shares the bowl: in twenty twenty one, it doubled the water it sends Jordan. The breed?
